payload.text:
Create a modern, premium, animated hybrid-structure portfolio website for a digital professional that combines personal branding with an agency-style presence.
The website should have a high-conversion one-page scrolling homepage, along with separate detailed pages for Case Studies, Services, and Contact.

Visual & Design Style:

• Dark theme with accent gradients (electric blue, purple, or orange)
• Clean grid layout with large, bold typography
• Smooth scroll-based animations, parallax effects, and micro-interactions
• Glassmorphism or soft glow UI elements for a high-end agency feel
• Minimal yet cinematic motion, elegant easing, and fast performance

Homepage (One-Page Scroll Experience):

Hero Section – Bold animated headline (e.g., “I Design, Build & Grow Digital Brands”), subtitle, and strong CTAs like View Case Studies and Let’s Work Together

Personal Brand Story – Short storytelling section with animated profile visuals and credibility-focused content

Services Overview – Interactive service cards for UI/UX Design, Web Development, Meta Ads Management, Social Media Handling, and Video Editing with hover animations

Featured Work Preview – Highlighted case studies with animated thumbnails linking to full case study pages

Process Section – Step-by-step workflow shown via animated timeline or motion graphics

Skills & Tools – Animated icons, progress indicators, and tech stack visuals

Social Proof – Testimonials or client logos with subtle animations

CTA Section – Strong conversion-focused contact callout with smooth animation

Inner Pages (Multi-Page Depth):

• Case Studies Page – Agency-style detailed project breakdowns with visuals, challenges, solutions, and results
• Services Page – In-depth service explanations with conversion-focused layout and visuals
• Contact Page – Minimal, animated contact form with social links and clear call-to-action

Overall Experience:

The site should feel cinematic, creative, trustworthy, and conversion-focused—appealing to startups, brands, and agencies. Fully responsive, mobile-first, fast-loading, SEO-friendly, and scalable for future growth.
Use subtle scroll-triggered animations and interaction feedback to make the experience feel alive without overwhelming the user.
Use subtle motion, elegant easing, and scroll-triggered animations to make the website feel alive while maintaining a clean and professional user experience.

**Developing the Blueprint**

I've been solidifying the core structure for the portfolio site. Thinking one-page scrolling for the homepage, then separate sections for case studies, services, and a contact form. This way it's clean and easy to navigate.


**Outlining Design & Tech**

I've been drilling down on the visual direction and tech stack. The dark theme with electric gradients and glassmorphism feels right. React 18 with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS are the frontrunners, with Framer Motion for animations. The component structure's taking shape, including all necessary pages and a solid folder structure. I'm focusing on the `metadata.json` structure, ensuring the content is streamlined to drive each page.


**Formulating Design Specs**

I'm now fully immersed in the design specs, establishing the visual DNA. I'm leaning heavily into a dark, gradient-infused aesthetic with large sans-serif typography. Interactions will leverage hover effects and scroll reveals. The process section will be a vertical timeline. The new hybrid-structure combines a scrolling homepage and separate pages accessible via the navigation.

payload.text: change the color and theme of the website .

**Developing a New Palette**

I'm exploring options for a new website theme. I'm moving away from the existing dark theme with accent gradients.  I've considered a "Midnight Emerald & Gold" palette, and also a "Sunset Rose & Deep Charcoal" theme.  Each theme will need to be refined before moving on.


**Choosing the Best Color Scheme**

I've been bouncing around different theme ideas. "Cyberpunk Crimson & Onyx" and "Nature-inspired Slate & Mint" felt like a good direction at first. But, after considering the user's feedback, I'm thinking of a "Sophisticated Obsidian & Rose Gold / Ember" theme, or maybe even a "Minimalist Monochrome with Neon Cyan". The most recent iteration is "Deep Midnight Green & Cyber Lime".


**Considering Theme Direction**

The "Pearlescent Light Theme" idea has been scrapped; it doesn't align with the premium feel. "Deep Forest & Gold" offers a premium, organic vibe with a dark green background and gold/bronze gradient.  I'm now contemplating "Cyberpunk Noir" with a black background and neon pink/deep purple gradient for an edgy feel. Also considered "Monochromatic Cyber Slate & Electric Cyan" with a deep slate background and cyan/blue gradient, which feels very "Tech" and "Agency." Finally, I'm working with a specification for an "Electric Cyan & Deep Space" theme.


**Selecting a Final Theme**

I'm now zeroing in on a "High-Contrast Neon Lime & Deepest Onyx" palette for the website refresh. The deepest onyx background will contrast starkly with the neon lime accents, creating a modern, tech-focused aesthetic. I'll need to update the gradient text, background classes, animated blobs, button styles, and glass borders to match this electric vibe. Navbar brand color, service card icons, and CTA section backgrounds will also require adjustments to align with the chosen palette. I believe this will deliver the modern "Tech/Agency" feeling the client is looking for.


**Focusing on a Refinement**

Okay, so I've pivoted again. I'm abandoning the Blue/Purple tones and focusing on "Crimson Ember & Obsidian," using `#080708`, `#ff4d4d`, `#f97316`, and `#fbbf24`. I need to update the `index.html` style section, the hero section blobs in `Home.tsx`, result borders in `CaseStudies.tsx`, service item borders in `Services.tsx`, and make subtle tweaks to the `Footer.tsx` & `Navbar.tsx`. It's a significant shift, but I think it will provide a really strong new direction for the site.


**Deciding on Final Colors**

I've been contemplating the most recent themes. I've considered "Rose & Deep Wine" for a unique feel. But, I've abandoned that quickly, and have landed on "Electric Lime & Graphite." The theme employs a black background with neon lime and mint accents, for an extremely modern aesthetic, appropriate for today's digital agencies. This is now the target specification, with a pure black background and the lime/mint/emerald gradient. I'm excited to update the website to this more modern feel!


**Adjusting Color Palettes**

I'm now implementing the color changes, starting with `CaseStudies.tsx` and `Services.tsx`. I'll update result item and service item borders to the new lime theme. It's a quick adjustment, but it's part of the overall refresh. I think it will look great!

To shift the website's aesthetic to a more cutting-edge, high-energy agency feel, I will implement a **"Neon Graphite & Electric Lime"** theme. This theme moves away from the traditional blue/purple palette toward a high-contrast, tech-focused look that is currently trending in top-tier digital design agencies.

1.  **Color Palette Overhaul**:
    *   **Background**: Deepened to a pure onyx black (`#000000`) for maximum contrast.
    *   **Primary Accent**: Electric Lime (`#c0ff00`) transitioning into a vibrant Mint (`#00ff9f`).
    *   **Secondary Accent**: Deep Cyber Cyan (`#0ea5e9`) for depth in gradients.
    *   **Text**: Crisp white for headings and a slightly muted "Silver Slate" for body text to improve readability.

2.  **Visual Styling**:
    *   **Gradients**: Updated all `gradient-text` and `gradient-bg` classes to use the new Lime-Mint-Cyan spectrum.
    *   **Glassmorphism**: Enhanced glass borders with a subtle lime-tinted glow on hover to make elements feel "charged."
    *   **Hero Section**: Updated the animated background "blobs" to pulse with Emerald and Cyan tones instead of Blue/Purple.

3.  **Component Adjustments**:
    *   **Navigation**: The signature rotating logo block will now feature the new Lime gradient.
    *   **Service Cards**: The icon containers and active borders will switch to the Lime/Mint theme.
    *   **Case Studies**: Performance result boxes will use Lime-accented borders to highlight success metrics more aggressively.
    *   **Contact Form**: Input focus states will glow with a Cyber Cyan hue.
